title: Chunked, resumable large-file transfer
description: §14.3.4 content-key blob is a single AES-128-GCM seal over the whole file with no chunking. Specify chunked encryption (per-chunk nonces/AAD binding chunk index and total, a manifest object listing chunk CIDs), dedup within a file, resumable and partial (range) fetch, size limits in Appendix C. Applies to attachments, recordings, scene assets. Needs design decisions.
